   - Comment-only: `third_property: # comment only`
   - Empty property: `fourth_property:`
   - Annotation-only: `fifth_property: '{{value6}}' # @annotation_only`

- Templates are in https://github.com/CODAIT/exchange-metadata-converter/tree/main/templates
- Annotations use `@annotation_key` format in comments
- Should not invalidate YAML files since they're comments
- Need to investigate what it takes to support this feature

Best practices to consider:
- Minimal changes to existing functionality
- Backward compatibility 
- Clear parsing of annotations from comments
- Proper handling of different annotation types (@optional, @annotation_only)
